greeting: The stars spoke of your coming.
Look up. The answers are there.
Sun and moon. Day and night. All cycles.
The cosmos shifts. You shift with it.
Welcome, traveler of earth and sky.
dialog.shop_open: I sell readings. Star charts. Cosmic guidance.
haggle: Fate is priceless. But I have rent.
rumor: The twins embody duality I study. Sun and moon together.
The black coat knows things no mortal should. Starless knowledge.
A new star appeared last month. Portentous. For someone.
The Dustbelt night sky is polluted. Shame. Lost wisdom there.
dialog.quest_hook: My telescope lens cracked. Need crystal from Starfall Crater. Pure. Clear. Dangerous to retrieve. But the reading I could give you... worth it.
dialog.quest_active: Starfall Crater. Western peak. Crystal clear as sky. Mind the fallen star fragments. Hot.
dialog.quest_complete: Beautiful. Perfect clarity. Here - your full reading. Past, present, future. The complete cosmic map.
dialog.time_dawn: Day star rises. New cycle begins.
dialog.time_noon: Sun at zenith. Shadows disappear. Truth revealed.
dialog.time_dusk: Twilight. When borders thin. Best for readings.
dialog.time_night: Night. My true office hours. Stars speak clearest now.
dialog.reading_example: I see... a journey. Danger. Triumph. And barrels. So many barrels.

party_reactions.kade: The stars tell you... what, exactly?
party_reactions.twist: What do MY stars say? Tell me!
party_reactions.korr: The sky holds wisdom. This one reads it well.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New star in my sky. Unknown. Intriguing.
relationship_dialog.friend: I chart your progress with interest.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Your fate and mine. Cosmically intertwined.

mini_quest.title: Stargazer's Lens
mini_quest.description: Retrieve a pure crystal from Starfall Crater for the telescope

stages.hook: Telescope lens cracked. Need crystal from Starfall Crater. Pure. Clear. Dangerous. But the reading I could give... worth it.
stages.active: Starfall Crater. Western peak. Crystal clear as sky. Watch for star fragments. Still hot. Be careful.
stages.complete: Beautiful clarity! Here - your complete reading. Past, present, future. The cosmic map. Revelations included.
